snippet.title: Titan Quest II | Early Access Update | Chapter 3: Arkadian Plains
snippet.description:
Chapter 3 is here! Today’s major Early Access update for Titan Quest II invites you to the Arkadian Plains into the middle of a war beween centaurs and humans.

Explore a war‑torn new region with new centaur and boarmen enemies, 4 bosses, new gear and epic items, plus 16 new quests. Discover 7 dungeons, the city of Tegea, the drought‑stricken Arkadian Plains, and even Olympos itself in brand-new, handcrafted maps. Become the rising hero the realms desperately need.

Read more: https://thqn.net/4r8QTgN
